svg.text: ESP32-C3 WiFi Sensor Node — Wiring Diagram
Indoor installation (shelter) with outdoor sensors — Wi-Fi to Pi 3B+ hub

g.text: DevKIT → Qwiic adapter → 100mm cable → LTC4311 → splice → Cat5 3–4 m → splice → 100mm cable → BME280
GPIO4 (ADC1) ← Vane | GPIO5 (INT) ← Rain | GPIO6 (INT) ← Anemo | GPIO8/9 → Qwiic → LTC4311 → Cat5 3–4m → BME280 | Wi-Fi → Pi 3B+
